description_fill_in: Unique identifier assigned to each news article entry in the dataset.
Identifier representing the publishing news outlet or content domain origin.
Total word count of the news article content indicating story depth and length.
Continuous compound polarity sentiment score ranging from -1.0 (strongly negative) to +1.0 (strongly positive).
Total count of exclamation marks (!) in the article text; proxy metric for sensationalism and emotional tone.
Proportion of uppercase words/characters to total text length; marker for clickbait capitalization and urgency.
Target classification ground truth: REAL denotes verified factual reporting; FAKE denotes fabricated/disinformation.
Editorial political leaning or bias of the reporting source (Left, Center, Right, or Unknown).
